d: We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Manager to lead and manage the organization's IT infrastructure across corporate offices, retail showrooms, warehouses etc. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in enterprise infrastructure, networking, cloud technologies, cybersecurity and IT service management, with proven experience in managing complex, multi-location IT environments.
q: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
Minimum 10–15 years of experience in IT infrastructure management, including at least 5 years in a managerial or leadership role.
Experience in the retail industry or large-scale, multi-location business environments is highly desirable.
Strong experience in managing enterprise IT infrastructure across multiple geographical locations.
Hands-on experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments, preferably Microsoft Azure or AWS.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, disaster recovery and business continuity management.
Proven experience in IT project management, budgeting, vendor management and team leadership.
Professional certifications such as ITIL, CCNP, Microsoft Azure, VMware, CISSP or PMP will be an added advantage.
r: li
Manage and oversee the organization's IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, reliability, security and scalability.
li

li

li

li

li
Lead IT infrastructure setup and implementation for new retail showrooms, warehouses and office expansions.
li

li

Monitor infrastructure performance, system availability, capacity utilization and network performance.

li

li
Ensure uninterrupted IT operations during peak retail hours, promotional campaigns and seasonal sales.
li
Manage IT infrastructure budgets, CAPEX, OPEX and technology procurement.
li

li
Maintain IT asset inventory, infrastructure documentation, network architecture and standard operating procedures.
li
Ensure compliance with IT governance, information security policies, internal controls and audit requirements.
li
Coordinate with ERP, application and business teams to ensure seamless integration and operational efficiency.
li
Identify opportunities for infrastructure optimization, automation and cost reduction.
li
Lead, mentor and develop the IT infrastructure and technical support teams.
